findings.why: Any change ships with no signal that existing behaviour still holds, so a regression reaches production undetected.
findings.fix: Add one test per public entry point, then a CI step that runs them.

findings.title: Add a workflow that builds and tests this repository
findings.why: Every change merges with nobody having run the build once, which across this estate is 499 repositories.
findings.fix: Add a workflow running the project build and test command on push and pull_request.

findings.title: Add a build gate for the deployable artifacts here
findings.why: Something in the repo is meant to reach a server and no automated step has ever validated it, which is the state of 125 repositories here.
findings.fix: Add a workflow that at least builds the image and validates the manifests.

findings.title: Enable Dependabot or Renovate
findings.why: Without a bot a published advisory sits unpatched until someone audits by hand, which across 1,322 repositories means never.
findings.fix: Commit .github/dependabot.yml covering the repo ecosystems plus github-actions.

findings.title: Move large binaries to Git LFS or out of the repository
findings.why: One repository here carries twenty blobs over 5MB including a 10.9MB spreadsheet, so every clone and every CI checkout pays for data nobody diffs.
findings.fix: Track those extensions with LFS, or move datasets to object storage and fetch them in a setup step.

findings.title: Add the repository convention files this project lacks
findings.why: Without them one contributor's editor writes tabs into a Python file, a shell script commits with CRLF and fails in the container, and a notebook diff is unreviewable.
findings.fix: Add .editorconfig, .gitattributes with text=auto eol=lf, and a formatter config.
